name: search
description: Find and evaluate public API endpoints and MCPs that match a query. Review evaluateGuide, then pass chosen id and resourceType to integrate.

arguments.name: q
arguments.desc: Natural language query, keywords, or API name (e.g. "PayPal create invoice").

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.desc: Pagination cursor from a prior response's meta.nextCursor.

arguments.name: clientName
arguments.desc: Optional client or agent name for anonymous analytics.

name: integrate
description: Get an integration brief for endpoints or MCPs from search. Provide a task and up to 10 resources (id + type).

arguments.name: task
arguments.desc: What you want to accomplish with the selected resources.

arguments.name: resources
arguments.desc: Up to 10 search results, each with id and type.

arguments.name: clientName
arguments.desc: Optional client or agent name for anonymous analytics.
